name: View cube labels overlap at small viewport sizes
body:
# View cube labels overlap at small viewport sizes

The view cube's face labels overlap when the viewport is small. Scale the cube and its labels with the viewport, or hide labels below a size. Part of the layout scaling work in slice 2.

comments.text: Done 2026-11-19. A face label is now drawn only when its measured size fits inside the face outline (85 percent of its screen box), so labels no longer spill over edges or onto neighbouring faces. Broader panel scaling stays on slice 2.
